name: WWT Slimbridge Play Areas
description: Welly Boot Land water play with climbing trees and basket swings (weather permitting), the Riverlife playground with a zip line and a tower with a wobbly bridge, lily pad trampolines, log tunnels and a Wild Play area for den building. Many areas are gated. Open 9.30am to 5.30pm.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the centre's tickets page for prices. WWT members get in free at all 10 wetland centres.
